heading: Small practices. Room for your whole life.
introduction: We begin with a desire to know God more deeply. These are invitations to explore, not promises of a particular outcome.

panels.title: Prayer & spiritual practice
panels.heading: Make room for God.
panels.description: Bring your attention, questions, gratitude, and ordinary life into prayer. Begin gently and notice what helps you return.

panels.title: Happiness & well-being
panels.heading: Notice the good.
panels.description: Explore gratitude, quiet, and attention to everyday life. Make room to notice what is meaningful without requiring yourself to feel a certain way.

panels.title: Relationships
panels.heading: Practice being present.
panels.description: Listen without rushing to fix. Ask an open question, make room for another person’s experience, and reflect on how to respond with care.

panels.title: Mental health
panels.heading: Care for your whole self.
panels.description: Attend to how a practice meets your life. Spiritual practice is not a substitute for mental health care; seek qualified support when you need it.

note: Prayer, mindfulness, and gratitude are distinct practices. Research about one does not establish the effects of another. Homeward does not promise numerical improvements in health or well-being.
